title: Virtua Cop 2
description: The quintessential arcade lightgun shooter. Aim, shoot gangsters, avoid civilians, and reload in full 3D action.

controls.desktop: Mouse Aim, Left Click Shoot, Right Click Reload, P Pause, ESC Release Mouse
controls.mobile: Touch screen to aim and shoot, on-screen Reload button, Landscape mode

title: Dangerous Dave
description: Guide Dave through perilous levels packed with fire pits, trophies, jetpacks, and lethal traps.

controls.desktop: Arrow Keys Move/Jump, Spacebar Jetpack / Fire, R Restart
controls.mobile: Touch D-pad, Jump button, Fire button, On-screen Restart

title: Road Rash
description: High-speed motorcycle combat racing across 5 punishing tracks. Kick, club, and outrun rivals and cops to claim cash and upgrades.

controls.desktop: Arrow Keys Steer/Accelerate/Brake, Space Punch/Kick/Club, Esc Pause
controls.mobile: Touch Steering, Gas/Brake pedals, Attack buttons, Fullscreen toggle

title: The House of the Dead 2
description: Survive the undead outbreak in Venice. Statically recompiled Sega NAOMI arcade architecture running via WebGL2 and WebAssembly.

controls.desktop: Mouse Aim, Left Click Shoot, Right Click Reload, 5 Coin, 1/Enter Start, 9 Test Menu
controls.mobile: Touch Target, Offscreen Touch to Reload, Landscape orientation

title: Mario Forever
description: The beloved PC fan game reborn. Experience challenging platforming across classic Worlds, power-ups, custom physics, and retro soundtrack.

controls.desktop: Arrow Keys Move/Duck, Z/Space Jump, X/Shift Run/Fireball, P Pause
controls.mobile: Touch D-Pad, A (Jump), B (Run/Fire), Landscape orientation

title: Contra
description: The iconic 2-player run-and-gun combat shooter. Infiltrate the Galuga archipelago, blast through alien defenses with 8-way directional aiming, Spread Gun, and acrobatics.

controls.desktop: Arrow Keys / WASD Aim & Move, J / Z Shoot, K / X Jump, Down + Jump Drop down
controls.mobile: Touch 8-Way D-Pad, Jump button, Fire button, Rapid-fire toggle

title: Batman: Gotham Duo
description: Sunsoft's legendary dark knight masterpiece reborn. Features Batman's iconic wall-jumping and gadgets, PLUS 2-Player Co-Op with Robin/Nightwing and a smart AI companion that fights beside you.

controls.desktop: Arrow Keys Move, Z Punch/Attack, X Jump/Wall Jump, C Sub-Weapon (Batarang), Space Switch Companion Mode
controls.mobile: Touch D-Pad, Punch, Jump (Wall Kick), Batarang gadget, AI Assist toggle
